import sys

def main():
    line = sys.stdin.readline()
    if not line:
        return
    parts = line.strip().split()
    m1, m2, m3 = int(parts[0]), int(parts[1]), int(parts[2])
    total = m1 + m2 + m3
    percentage = total * 100.0 / 300
    print(total)
    print("{:.2f}".format(percentage))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
